pronunciation: buy-buy (both tones fall gently, like saying "bye-bye" but low and even)
meaning: to worship or pay respects to gods/ancestors with offerings (e.g. at a temple or home altar)

example.english: At New Year we need to go worship at the temple.

note: 拜拜 is used constantly around Taiwanese festivals — for ancestor worship, temple visits, or even just thanking household gods before a meal; the doubled syllable softens it into a routine, everyday-sounding act rather than a solemn ritual.
